name: shopify-liquid-shapes
description: File checks over a Shopify storefront rendered through Liquid, aimed at the head and pagination sins the Shopify app/theme shape reliably produces. The Liquid-leak trap: a {% comment %} or a raw {{ output }} that survived into baked HTML because a theme/app failed to render it. The app-meta trap: Shopify emits platform meta (og:type, twitter:card, og:image) and an installed app injects a second copy, so the head contradicts itself. The pagination-canonical trap: a paginated collection whose canonical drops the page param, de-indexing every page past the first. Zero network, zero HTML execution - attribute reads only.
